character.description: An original 1990s PC and console game hero: practical frontier scout with readable silhouette, compact gear and no resemblance to an existing franchise character
character.face: distinct original angular face with simple game-art readability
character.build: athletic compact silhouette designed for low-resolution readability
character.costume: weathered field jacket, utility belt, boots and simple shoulder gear with no logos

style.name: original-mid-1990s-game-production-art
style.description: Original mid-1990s computer and console game production art combining hand-painted concept-art sensibility, limited-colour sprite readability, slightly chunky forms and era-appropriate illustrated packaging atmosphere; draw from broad 1990s shooter, strategy, JRPG, beat-em-up, vertical-shooter, dungeon-sim and RTS production traditions without copying any existing franchise, character, unit or interface
style.medium: hand-painted digital game concept illustration with sprite-conscious shape design
style.lighting: simple dramatic key light with readable shadow grouping

continuity_locks: no franchise logos or recognizable copied assets

shots.framing: full figure with comfortable negative space
